title: Beat It 6x6 (Zipper Lines Chaos Construction)
author: MaizeGator
rules:
This puzzle is part of the puzzle pack
Chaotic Construction
by the Sudoku Skunkworks.

This is an easier, 6x6 version of a 9x9 puzzle with the same ruleset that I will publish soon.

Rules:

Chaos Construction:
Divide the grid into regions of 6 orthogonally connected cells each,
such that every cell belongs to exactly one region. Place the digits
1 to 6 exactly once in each row, column, and region.

Zipper lines:
Cells on a purple line
equidistant from the circle must
belong to the same region and their
digits must sum to the digit in the
circle. The region including the circle
may not take any other cells along
that line.

Sight circles:
Digits in purple circles
indicate the number of cells seen
horizontally and vertically within the
same region, including itself. Cells
from other regions block vision.
